name: print-social-volunteer-call-lime-and-black-poster
title: Volunteer call in black with lime pills and giant cropped word
whatItIs: A white poster with black bold headline 'Call for Volunteers', lime pill labels for roles (Designers, Writers, Video Editors, Content Managers) with megaphone icons, and a huge black word 'Volunteers' cropped at the bottom on a lime block.
whatItMeans: Energetic and inclusive; pill roles make it feel like choosing a badge, and the giant word closes the poster.
techniques: Show open roles as lime pills.
Crop a giant word at the bottom edge for scale and drama.
Contrast black type with white and lime.
Use small pointing icons to guide reading.

vocabulary.definition: A capsule naming a job or role.
A word cut by the frame's edge.
Black type against a neon highlight.
A section prompting the reader to act.
